items.q: Miss Young had this big show, Likeman(?) and Carson. So we went over to that show, and he took me and Pete with him

ctx.x: Yeah. He said, "I'm going to turn this show over to Kitchen and let him take it." So he turned it over to him, and he took me... Miss Young had this big show, Likeman(?) and Carson. So we went over to that show, and he took me and Pete with him, and Les... Lester had already gone
